claims.claim: Gamma Free allows up to 10 slides per prompt and provides one-time credits.
Gamma Plus is USD 9 per month on annual billing with 1000 credits per month.
Beautiful.ai Pro is USD 12 per month billed annually with unlimited AI content generation and slides.
Canva Pro is displayed as USD 144 per year and an AI allowance up to 2000 Standard uses as an estimate.
Microsoft 365 Business Standard with Copilot is USD 23.50 per user per month paid yearly and includes PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Teams and 1TB storage.
